mission.title: The Zero One
mission.description: Learn what an informant knows about the human Morpheus thought was the One before Neo.

npc.say: I'm tired of those Agents thinking that they can push us around!
Those stupid Agents won't know what hit them.

phase.briefing: You will investigate rumors of a previous "One" in Morpheus' past. While the reasons behind Morpheus' termination remain a mystery, any information about his past may assist us in tracing and eliminating the rogue agencies involved with the Assassin. We are sending you to meet with a reliable informant who claims to have first-hand knowledge of a human who Morpheus thought was the "One," before he met Mr. Anderson.

enter.say: The informant, Zverev, agreed to meet in that building. He thinks you represent a rival faction. While his profile indicates that he has every incentive to cooperate, the Machines aren't absolutely sure we can trust him, so proceed with caution.

talk.say: Hey, you're who I'm supposed to meet, right? Thanks for the advance in my bank account--I like the way you folks do business. So what can I tell you about this other "One" that Morpheus had once upon a time? Well, --hey! Did you hear something? Aw cripes, it's gotta be those Agents on my ass again! You gotta help me out!

"Agents"? According to my readings, those aren't Agents, they're the imposters! Why would they have come back just to silence Zverev? There must be something he isn't telling us, but you'd better take them out before they get to him.
Oh no! Oh no! They tracked me down!

done.say: That's all of the imposters in the area. Zverev should be ready to talk now.

objective.text: Get the Business Card from Zverev

talk.say: Th-thanks. I owe you one. Eh, listen, I think we'd better break up our little meeting here. Take this business card--I'll meet you at that address in a little while, okay? See you then.

done.say: Zverev's skittishness is really holding this mission up. Maybe there's something we can do without him. Leave the area and I'll send you further instructions.

phase.briefing: It seems that contact Zverev has done something to tempt the imposter Agents back into the dangers of the Matrix. He will not be comfortable enough to divulge his information if they are allowed to remain in the area. We have located a band of the imposters nearby. Proceed to their location and destroy them.

enter.say: The imposter Agents are in that building. Make sure you get all of them.

done.say: All right, you got all the imposters. I don't know who that other guy is, but he seems harmless. Go on and leave the area.
Oh, uh, I don't... err... Thanks for rescuing me! They kidnapped me and brought me here, I don't know why. Really, thanks!

phase.briefing: The address from contact Zverev's business card is now uploading to you. You will proceed there and meet with Zverev.

enter.say: The area appears to be empty. You'd better search the premises.
I'm starting to think this is a waste of time. I'll bet Zverev has... wait a sec. I'm picking up multiple signals entering the area. That better be him!
Ah, it's Zverev and... friends of his, I guess.

talk.say: Hey, you made it! Okay, I got a few of my buddies, and we're ready to go get rid of those Agents for good! You ready to roll?
Zverev's lucky that these aren't real Agents after him. I guess we'd better humor him though, since we still need his info.
Come on! I found out where the Agents are camped out--we'll go wipe 'em out in a surprise attack!

objective.text: Lead Zverev out of the area

phase.briefing: The location of the imposter Agents, according to Zverev, is now being uploaded to you.

enter.say: Scanners are detecting powerful programs in that building--it looks like Zverev's data was correct. Just don't let him get himself killed, we still need his information on Morpheus' previous "One."

done.say: That's all the bad guys, soldier.

talk.say: That guy again? He couldn't have been "kidnapped" twice! Hold up, it looks like Zverev wants to talk to Aaron Upson. Maybe they know each other?
Aaa! Keep that psycho Zverev away from me!
What? Aaron Upson here? Where? Take me to that lying weasel!

done.say: Whoa, Zverev killed Upson! And now he wants you to put his business card on the body. I guess that if Upson was leading the imposters to Zverev, that explains why you ran into him earlier today.
Ha! That'll teach that lying rat Upson to double-cross me. He's the one who's been telling the Agents where I am! Tell you what--put that Business Card I gave you on Upson's body.

objective.text: Put the Business Card on Upson's body

done.say: Ugh. This Zverev guy is on quite the ego trip.
Looks like you're all done there. Go ahead and lead Zverev outside.
Great! That'll be my "calling card"--haha! Poor old Upson--he always was a mean son of a gun, but I didn't figure he'd've had the guts to try anything on me.

phase.briefing: Zverev seems particularly pleased with himself--we trust that this will increase his lucidity regarding the history of Morpheus' earlier "One." Take him to the indicated safehouse and interrogate him.

enter.say: Zverev is anxious about the status of his next payment. Lead him to the active computer in the area--he'll be able to check his account from there.

objective.text: Lead Zverev to the active computer

done.say: Zverev should be ready to deliver his part of the agreement now. Talk to him about Morpheus' previous "One."

objective.text: Talk to Zverev about Morpheus' previous "One"

talk.say: Okay, my account looks good so here's the scoop: way before he found Neo, Morpheus thought this other dude was the "One." This fella was one of those "extreme athlete" types: loved danger, huge ego and all that. He could pull off stunts you wouldn't believe, and he could learn skills incredibly quickly, especially combat stuff. He was also a real jerk and loved the idea of being everyone's "savior." So anyway-- Hey wait, did you hear something?

done.say: Huh, it doesn't sound like that previous "One" has anything to do with the Assassin. The Machines are telling me to have you leave Zverev there for the imposters to deal with. You'd better get outside.

complete.say: Oh no, it's the Agents, they've found me again! You gotta help me out here. W-wait, where are you going? We had a deal! Waaaaaait!

mission.finish: We may have been a bit hasty in allowing Zverev to be eliminated. Perhaps we should discover what became of this previous "One" found by Morpheus. We shall have to find a more... reliable source of information.
